Total Tube Lines.description: Network-wide distinct monitored line IDs, as calculated by the SQL summary; ignores report filters.

Total Historical Snapshots.description: Network-wide distinct collection timestamps. A timestamp shared by 11 lines counts once.

Observed Good Service %.expression: 100.0 * DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'analytics vw_operational_kpi_summary'[good_service_observations] ), REMOVEFILTERS () ), CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'analytics vw_operational_kpi_summary'[total_line_observations] ), REMOVEFILTERS () ) )
Observed Good Service %.description: Network-wide Good Service line/snapshot observations divided by all line/snapshot observations, on a 0-100 scale. Not uptime.

Observed Disruption %.expression: 100.0 * DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'analytics vw_operational_kpi_summary'[disrupted_observations] ), REMOVEFILTERS () ), CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'analytics vw_operational_kpi_summary'[total_line_observations] ), REMOVEFILTERS () ) )
Observed Disruption %.description: Network-wide disrupted line/snapshot observations divided by all line/snapshot observations, on a 0-100 scale. Not incident counts.

Line Observed Good Service %.description: Weighted ratio of counts for selected Tube lines; never sums stored percentage columns.

Daily Observed Disruption %.description: Daily network-wide ratio of disrupted to all line/snapshot observations. Dates come from the SQL Europe/London calendar.

Status Record Count.description: Raw service-status records grouped by description. Multiple statuses can occur at the same line/snapshot; this is not a snapshot or incident count.

Major Disruption Snapshots.description: Distinct line/snapshot observations matching any SQL-defined major category: Severe Delays, Part Closure, Part Suspended or Planned Closure. A snapshot matching multiple categories counts once per line.

Line Snapshots Observed.description: Line/snapshot observations for the selected lines. Totals across lines are not distinct collection timestamps.

Daily Collection Times.description: Distinct collection timestamps per observed local date, summed only across disjoint dates.

Daily Line Observations.description: Number of observed line/snapshot pairs per local date.

Status Record Share %.expression: 100.0 * DIVIDE ( [Status Record Count], CALCULATE ( [Status Record Count], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'analytics vw_disruption_severity' ) ) )
Status Record Share %.description: Share of raw status records; denominator differs from the observation-based KPI denominator.

Severe Delay Snapshots.description: Observed snapshots with Severe Delays. Category counts can overlap; do not add them to obtain the major total.

Closure or Suspension Snapshots.description: Observed snapshots with Part Closure or Part Suspended. Category counts can overlap; do not add them to obtain the major total.

Planned Closure Snapshots.description: Observed snapshots with Planned Closure; included in the SQL major-status union. Category counts can overlap; do not add them to obtain the major total.

Status Record Color.description: Category-based colors, without treating severity codes as a numeric scale.

Observation Context.expression:
VAR LatestObservation = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'analytics vw_operational_kpi_summary'[latest_snapshot_time] ), REMOVEFILTERS () )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( LatestObservation ), "No imported observations", "Latest imported observation: " & FORMAT ( LatestObservation, "dd MMM yyyy HH:mm" ) & " (model time)" )
        & "  |  Import mode; refresh timestamp unavailable"
Observation Context.description: Latest imported observation timestamp, not the time of model refresh. No refresh timestamp exists in the supplied model.
